title: A Suitcase That Did Not Arrive
summaryZh: 旅客抵達機場後找不到行李，在服務櫃台描述行李並安排送到飯店。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Good evening. How can I help you?
sentences.zh: 晚安。請問需要什麼協助？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: My suitcase did not arrive on my flight from Seoul.
sentences.zh: 我從首爾搭機過來，但我的行李箱沒有抵達。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I'm sorry to hear that. May I see your baggage tag?
sentences.zh: 很抱歉發生這種事。可以讓我看您的行李牌嗎？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Here it is. The tag number ends in four seven two.
sentences.zh: 在這裡。行李牌號碼最後三碼是四七二。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Thank you. Could you describe the suitcase?
sentences.zh: 謝謝。您可以描述一下行李箱嗎？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: It is a medium black case with a red ribbon on the handle.
sentences.zh: 它是一個中型黑色行李箱，把手上綁著紅色緞帶。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Does it have any other marks or labels?
sentences.zh: 還有其他記號或標籤嗎？

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Yes, there is a silver name tag on the side.
sentences.zh: 有，側面有一個銀色姓名牌。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Our system shows that it stayed behind in Seoul.
sentences.zh: 我們的系統顯示它留在首爾了。
sentences.note: stay behind 表示其他人或物離開後仍留在原地。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: When do you expect it to arrive?
sentences.zh: 你們預計它什麼時候會抵達？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: It should arrive on the next flight tomorrow morning.
sentences.zh: 它應該會搭明天早上的下一班飛機抵達。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Can you deliver it to my hotel?
sentences.zh: 你們可以把它送到我的飯店嗎？

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Certainly. Please write down the hotel address and your phone number.
sentences.zh: 當然可以。請寫下飯店地址和您的電話號碼。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I'm staying at the Grand Harbor Hotel for two nights.
sentences.zh: 我會在 Grand Harbor Hotel 住兩晚。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: If you buy essential items tonight, please keep your receipts.
sentences.zh: 如果您今晚購買必需品，請保留收據。
sentences.note: essential items 指盥洗用品或換洗衣物等必要物品。

questions.q: How does the traveler describe the suitcase?
